students_registered.label: Students registered
students_registered.query: SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM "User" WHERE role = 'STUDENT' AND NOT (email IS NULL AND "createdAt" >= '2026-09-10T07:23:00Z' AND "createdAt" < '2026-09-10T07:37:00Z')

countries_represented.label: Countries represented
countries_represented.query: SELECT DISTINCT "countryCode" AS code FROM "User" WHERE role = 'STUDENT' AND "countryCode" IS NOT NULL AND NOT (email IS NULL AND "createdAt" >= '2026-09-10T07:23:00Z' AND "createdAt" < '2026-09-10T07:37:00Z') ORDER BY 1  -- value = number of rows

mentorship_sessions_held.label: Mentorship sessions held
mentorship_sessions_held.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT b."slotId")::int AS n FROM "Booking" b JOIN "MentorSlot" s ON s.id = b."slotId" WHERE b.status = 'COMPLETED' AND s."startsAt" < now()

papers_published.label: Papers published
papers_published.query: count of entries in JOURNAL_PAPERS, src/lib/journal/papers.ts

queries.country_codes: SELECT DISTINCT "countryCode" AS code FROM "User" WHERE role = 'STUDENT' AND "countryCode" IS NOT NULL AND NOT (email IS NULL AND "createdAt" >= '2026-09-10T07:23:00Z' AND "createdAt" < '2026-09-10T07:37:00Z') ORDER BY 1

queries.country_codes_all_students: SELECT DISTINCT "countryCode" AS code FROM "User" WHERE role = 'STUDENT' AND "countryCode" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
